_comment: Hand-authored pattern config for the mixed-color keycap compositor (Phase 2 GUI). Never touched by the Phase 1 extraction script. Schema: positions/availableColors are just references (must match masks\*.png / the 7 source photo names); each pattern maps every position to a palette-slot index in [0, numColors). At composite time the GUI assigns one of the availableColors to each slot index and paints position P with the tile for (P, colorAssignedToSlot[keys[P]]).

patterns.name: Rows
patterns.description: Three-tone split by physical row on the board: top row (edit/option/up), middle row (left/down/right), bottom row (shift/play).

patterns.name: Columns
patterns.description: Four-tone split by physical column on the board: left (left), center-left (up/down/shift), center-right (option/right/play), right (edit).

patterns.name: Rainbow
patterns.description: Four-tone pattern spreading colors across all 8 keys for maximum variety (no layout logic, just a fixed varied assignment).

patterns.name: Blocks
patterns.description: Three-tone: arrows (up/down/left/right) one color, option/edit another, play/shift another.

patterns.name: Navigator
patterns.description: Three-tone: arrows (up/down/left/right) one color, option/shift another, play/edit another.

patterns.name: Commander
patterns.description: Four-tone: up/down one color, left/right another, shift/option another, play/edit another.

patterns.name: Pilot
patterns.description: Four-tone: left/right one color, up/down another, option/edit another, shift/play another.
